event.dorian_heart2.0.text: Shh. Stand where I am. Look.
event.dorian_heart2.0.why: drops 'Slowly', which had become wallpaper across five scenes

dlg.story.notes.dorian.r1.text: You're welcome. I'll go be flustered behind a tree.
dlg.story.notes.dorian.r1.why: the scene's intro already opens on 'Oh.'

dlg.story.notes.dorian.r2.text: For me? ...I'll read it in the forest. Twice.
dlg.story.notes.dorian.r2.why: breaks the 'A <noun>.' opener shape repeated across scenes

event.story_notes_dorian.after.text: Three more doors before dark. Don't follow. Don't guess.
event.story_notes_dorian.after.why: intro already said paper beats faces; the close is now only the thread

dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.2.text: ...Borrowed. The mushrooms needed a roof. It was coming back.
dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.2.why: intro already says 'for spores'; this answers Tilda, not the player

event.story_pumpkin_dorian.after.text: Next fall I'll grow my own. Tilda may forgive me. The goats won't.
event.story_pumpkin_dorian.after.why: 'goes back tonight' clashed with the carry-it-back branch; now works for all three

event.dorian_heart8.intro.text: Sit. The log. I'll show you something. Don't speak yet.
event.dorian_heart8.intro.why: fewer leading ellipses; the nerves are in the orders

dlg.dorian.notebook.r0.text: Lovely. First time for that word. It goes in the margin.
dlg.dorian.notebook.r0.why: n1 already says 'Nobody's seen them'; avoids a second 'Nobody's'

event.dorian_heart8.after.text: {if choice:notebook.praise}You said lovely. The next page is yours. I'll draw you as a mushroom.{else}{if choice:notebook.ask}The brown one's yours. Don't lose it. I'll miss it. A little.{else}Your mushroom lives in the notebook now. Page one. Crooked. Perfect.{/if}{/if}
event.dorian_heart8.after.why: praise branch no longer promises a step gift the game does not deliver; leaves 'which mushroom am I?'

dlg.dorian.birthday.r1.text: Good. There's a spot where the moss is thick.
dlg.dorian.birthday.r1.why: breaks the 'A <noun>.' opener shared with r2 and other scenes

dlg.dorian.birthday.r2.why: 'best one' was said twice in this scene

event.dorian_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.dorian.wish}Quiet words. I kept them. They fit in a pocket.{else}{if choice:bday.dorian.walk}We walked. Said little. Good birthday. Marcus can stop asking.{else}The pinecone's on my shelf. Not from the forest. From you.{/if}{/if}
event.dorian_birthday.after.why: cone branch drops the repeated 'Best one'; the catchphrase turn stays

dlg.dorian.courtship.r0.text: ...Yes. I wasn't sure. I'll show you the quiet places. All of them.

event.dorian_courtship.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.dorian.yes}Tomorrow, a walk. No talking until the third tree. After, maybe.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.dorian.friends}Friends. Good word. I'll keep it somewhere mossy.{else}Take your time. I'll be where the moss is. Not hiding.{/if}{/if}
event.dorian_courtship.after.why: wait branch no longer says 'waiting' right after r2 did

event.dorian_courtship2.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.dorian.yes}Tomorrow, a walk. No talking until the third tree. After, maybe.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.dorian.friends}Friends. Good word. I'll keep it somewhere mossy.{else}Longer, then. The oak's patient. I'm learning from it.{/if}{/if}
event.dorian_courtship2.after.why: cuts a fourth 'Mostly'; the second wait still admits effort

event.dorian_partners.intro.text: I made something. A feather, a stick, some twine. It isn't much. Hold it.
event.dorian_partners.intro.why: 'Sit.' already opens heart 8; fewer leading ellipses

dlg.dorian.partners.0.text: Today's ours. I didn't plan past this.
dlg.dorian.partners.0.why: scene plays 8 to 17, so 'evening' was wrong

dlg.dorian.partners.r1.text: The forest, then. Past the third tree this time. The old oak listens.
dlg.dorian.partners.r1.why: remembers the courtship promise, certain by the scene's yes-flag

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_1.l2.why: leading ellipsis thinned so it stays a signature

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_2.l4.text: Me too. Plane, please. That's my words for the week.

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l2.text: Oak. Good. First door I'd close on purpose.

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_4.l4.text: The owl will want a name. I'll wait till it tells me.

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_2.l1.text: Old mushroom guide. I pressed leaves in it. Years of them.

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_3.l3.text: Then the trees can join us. They're good at it.

threads.dorian_heart2: Where is the other place further in, and when is 'not yet' over?
threads.dorian_heart5: Edmund was counting the trees here; how far did he get, and why count them?
threads.story_notes_dorian: Three more doors before dark: who else gets Dorian's notes?
threads.story_pumpkin_dorian: What was growing in the pumpkin, and will Dorian grow his own next fall?
threads.dorian_heart8: Praise: which mushroom will he draw the player as? Otherwise the notebook now holds something of the player's.
threads.dorian_birthday: The shelf where Dorian keeps the things he's given.
threads.dorian_courtship: The walk tomorrow, and what he says after the third tree.
threads.dorian_courtship2: The walk tomorrow, or how long the oak teaches him to wait.
threads.dorian_partners: The shelf by the notebook, and what lies past the third tree.
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_1: Marcus leaves words for Dorian on purpose; how long has he done that?
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_2: Two men who spend a week's words on a plane: what are they building?
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_3: A door Dorian will leave open, mostly: when does he close it?
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_4: The owl outside the new window, still without a name.

notes: Round 1 notes naming Dorian (pumpkin third-person close) were already fixed in R1; the R2 close now also works for the 'carry it back' branch, where 'goes back tonight' had contradicted Tilda's r2.
Variety pass: leading '...' was on ~20 lines and 'Slowly'/'Mostly'/'Best one' repeated across scenes; thinned so they stay signatures. 'Mostly' now only in overheard_marcus_dorian_3 and notebook r1.
heart8 praise branch promised a gift on the step tomorrow; no effect delivers one, so it now promises a drawing in the notebook instead.
For Hazel: overheard_dorian_hazel_1 has 'Good morning' but the scene plays 9 to 19; consider a time-neutral greeting.
For Ione: reading_night closing line repeats 'A snowdrop, for the lamp' right after Dorian says it; intentional echo is fine, but she may want her own words.
